label: B25-BRAM-NONCIRCULAR-ORACLE
title: Replace the stale reset-word constant with an ELF-derived BRAM image oracle
scope: Implement the approved non-circular BRAM initialization oracle. Parse the AArch64 ELF load image/symbols independently, structurally validate the reset LDR-literal target and MOV SP,X0, cross-check complete BIN/HEX/MIF content and zero padding, generate a hash-bound expected byte image, and make lcvex_bram_init25_tb consume that expected image instead of a layout-dependent 64-bit constant.
writes: build/agents/T-20260909-001/** and fpga/catapult_a10/boot/build/** ignored generated artifacts
reads: lcvex_bram_boot behavioral model and existing T-039/T-007 tests
validation: Positive: current ELF/BIN/HEX/MIF produce an independent 64 KiB expected image; LDR X0 literal resolves to __stack_top=0x10000 and instruction 1 is MOV SP,X0; updated TB passes and retains 0xFFFC/0xFFFF/0x10000 boundary checks.
Cross-artifact: exact ELF PT_LOAD derived bytes equal BIN and HEX; MIF is WIDTH=64 DEPTH=8192 with 8192 records and correct little-endian bytes plus zero padding.
Negative: missing/wrong path, reset-byte/imm19/MOV mutation, byte/word reversal, HEX/BIN mismatch, MIF lane/record mismatch, nonzero padding and stale expected hash each fail at the intended layer.
Runner must treat TB FAIL text as failure even if simulation exits 0; compile/run heavy work under local resource-lock with task-local TMPDIR.
acceptance: The test no longer hardcodes a link-dependent imm19, derives no expected data from DUT/HEX/MIF, detects the fault-injection matrix, and passes the current authoritative 0x9100001f58001700 image without weakening boundary/byte-lane checks.

resource.policy: Boot/checker-only work may be light; every Verilator build/run uses resource-lock run local, task-local TMPDIR, bounded jobs; return 75 means wait.

integration_note: Owner must not edit shared Makefile/scripts/test_registry.json. Integrator registers the new runner after acceptance and reruns it on the combined T-007+T-20260909-001 candidate.

integrator_validation.result: PASS including 13/13 negative injections and BRAM_INIT25_TB PASS
